 Order

The petitioner is the accused in S.C.No.685 of 2025 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court,
Kollam, which arose out of Crime No. 2 of 2018 of Paravoor Police Station, Kollam.

The offence alleged against him are under Sections 376 and 417 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

The prosecution case is that during the period from 2010 to 2013, the petitioner indulged in sexual relationship with the defacto complainant, after the performance of the marriage with her in a mosque.
It is further alleged that the relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant continued up to 2015, at various places.
But, later on, he abandoned the de facto complainant.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.
4. The prosecution records itself would reveal that the sexual relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant, was with the full consent of the defacto complainant.

It is also seen that a marriage ceremony is said to have been performed at a Mosque, and it is consequent to the above marriage that the petitioner indulged in 2025:KER:59602 sexual relationship with the defacto complainant.
Thus, it is apparent that the relationship was with the consent of the defacto complainant.
The statement of the defacto complainant would reveal that she was fully aware of the fact that the petitioner was already married to another woman, right from the very beginning.
5. In the above circumstances, it is not possible to say that the defacto complainant extended her consent for sexual relationship due any misconception of facts.
The offence of rape is prima facie not attracted in the facts and circumstances of the case.
Therefore, the prayer of the petitioner to quash the proceedings against him, is fully justified.
In the result, the petition stands allowed.

The proceedings against the petitioner/accused in S.C.No.685 of 2025 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court, Kollam, which arose out of Crime No. 2 of 2018 of Paravoor Police Station, Kollam, are hereby quashed.
